one_idea: At the same periodic N=64 record length, endpoint shape redistributes one normalized spectral kernel: narrower main lobes, peak sidelobes, and far-sidelobe falloff are separate measurements rather than one universal window ranking.

source_contract.handoff: Four aligned rows pairing periodic w[n] at N=64 with normalized dense direct-DTFT spectra on a common -110-to-0 dB axis; exact first-null guides at +/-1, +/-2, +/-2, and +/-4 current-record bins; peak sidelobe and far falloff labeled separately.
source_contract.surrounding_section: Endpoint behavior exchanges a narrow main lobe for lower sidelobes; the following subsection distinguishes smoothness-controlled far-field decay from nearby peak sidelobes.
source_contract.rights: Original analytic plot generated from declared formulas. Harris and J. O. Smith remain mathematical references; no source image is copied or embedded.

windows.name: 4-term Blackman-Harris
windows.far_falloff: not used as the ranking metric here

composition.reading_order: Common convention and normalization header, then rectangular, Hann, Hamming, and Blackman-Harris rows from narrowest to widest main lobe.
composition.desktop: Four aligned rows; formula header above a paired time-shape and spectrum grid.
composition.mobile: Each row stacks its time shape directly above its spectrum while keeping formula, peak sidelobe, and far-falloff labels attached.
composition.color_redundancy: Every window is named, occupies its own row, and also has a distinct line style or currentColor role; null widths and metrics are literal text.
composition.math: All formulas are rendered through M/KaTeX; SVG contains only curves, axes, guides, endpoint dots, and short labels.

defects_seen: Time plots were bottom-aligned against taller spectrum plots, creating a vertical gap between each row formula and its time-shape label.
fixes: Changed the pair grid from end alignment to start alignment so time and spectrum titles share the same visual baseline.

render_look_fix.verdict: PASS in desktop and 360 px mobile layouts, light and dark. No clipping, collision, broken KaTeX, horizontal overflow, or detached label was seen.
